official_source.topic: V2 retirement cannot use Node diskStatus disappearance as runtime release proof
official_source.conclusion: NodeController.alignDiskSpecAndStatus logs DiskDelete error but still deletes diskStatus. AIO DiskDelete unregisters bdev and propagates errors; NVMe DiskDelete logs certain detach/unbind errors but returns true,nil. Virtio-blk differs: its relevant errors propagate. Native status/RPC success are insufficient retirement proof. Require actual disk/bdev/controller absence, restored original PCI binding where applicable, hardware identity, drained data graph and healthy business before releasing receipts/removing hardware. No product retirement implementation or field reproduction is added; do not classify this source finding as a reproduced runtime product bug.
